description: daylii is a consumer-first HSA/FSA platform that modernizes how 50M Americans manage $150B in tax-advantaged funds. We streamline education, eligibility, and spending through an AI-driven marketplace and automation layer, reducing waste, increasing utilization, and unlocking actionable SKU-level insights for employers, TPAs, retailers, and CPG brands.
problem_statement: daylii is solving the fact that HSA/FSA accounts are confusing, underutilized, and built on 30-year-old infrastructure, causing consumers to overspend, underspend, or lose money, and leaving employers/TPAs with avoidable service costs. This matters because $150B flows through these accounts annually, yet ~$4B in FSA funds expire each year and tens of billions in HSA dollars sit idle, directly harming consumers and wasting benefits budgets. By modernizing education, eligibility, and spending—and connecting it to a real-time, AI-powered marketplace—daylii reduces waste, increases savings, and gives every stakeholder (consumers, employers, TPAs, retailers, and CPG brands) access to clearer value and better outcomes.

team.justification: The founding team has relevant domain expertise and a strong personal connection, which can be advantageous for team cohesion. However, the team is small, with only two members, and relies on contracted engineers, which may limit execution capability and scalability.

company_assessment.business_model_strength: The business model leverages a revenue-sharing agreement with Walmart and a subscription or percentage fee model for the monitoring platform. This dual approach provides multiple revenue streams but requires validation through market traction.
company_assessment.market_positioning: daylii positions itself as a modern solution to outdated HSA/FSA management systems, with a unique value proposition of reducing costs and increasing utilization through AI-driven insights.
company_assessment.execution_capability: The team has demonstrated initial execution capability by securing a partnership with Walmart and generating significant social media impressions. However, the lack of a full-time engineering team may hinder rapid product development.
company_assessment.strategic_vision: The strategic vision is clear, focusing on modernizing HSA/FSA management and expanding partnerships with TPAs and retailers. The founders' previous entrepreneurial experience adds credibility to their strategic planning.
